sesotho_text: Empa Jehova o rata ba mo tšabang Ka lerato le sa felengLe litloholo tsa bona o tla li tšoara ka tsela e lokileng,
english_text: But the loyal love of Jehovah is for all eternity Toward those who fear him, And his righteousness toward their children's children,

sesotho_text: Balaoli ha ba tšajoe ke batho ba etsang lintho tse ntle empa ba tšajoa ke ba etsang lintho tse mpe. Ha u sa batle ho tšaba balaoli, u 'ne u etse lintho tse ntle 'me ba tla u rorisa.
english_text: For those rulers are an object of fear, not to the good deed, but to the bad. Do you want to be free of fear of the authority? Keep doing good, and you will have praise from it;

sesotho_text: Ba sebeletsa Molimo molemong oa hao. Empa u lokela ho tšoha haeba u etsa lintho tse fosahetseng hobane ba fuoe matla le tokelo ea ho otla ba etsang lintho tse fosahetseng. Ke basebeletsi ba Molimo ba otlang batho ba etsang lintho tse fosahetseng.
english_text: for it is God's minister to you for your good. But if you are doing what is bad, be in fear, for it is not without purpose that it bears the sword. It is God's minister, an avenger to express wrath against the one practicing what is bad.

sesotho_text: Fang bohle tse ba lokelang, ea batlang lekhetho la mofuta ofe kapa ofe le mo fe lona, ea batlang ho tšajoa le mo tšabe, ea batlang ho hlomphuoa le mo hlomphe.
english_text: Render to all their dues: to the one who calls for the tax, the tax; to the one who calls for the tribute, the tribute; to the one who calls for fear, such fear; to the one who calls for honor, such honor.

sesotho_text: Le se ke la kolota mang kapa mang letho haese lerato kaha ea ratang oa habo o phethahalitse molao.
english_text: Do not owe anything to anyone except to love one another; for whoever loves his fellow man has fulfilled the law.

sesotho_text: Molimo a bōpa motho ka setšoantšo sa hae, a mo bōpa ka setšoantšo sa Molimo; a ba bōpa e le e motona le e motšehali.
english_text: And God went on to create the man in his image, in God's image he created him; male and female he created them.

sesotho_text: Ho ne ho e-s'o ka ho e-ba le lihlahla le limela lefatšeng hobane Jehova Molimo o ne a e-s'o nese pula 'me ho ne ho se na motho ea ka lemang.
english_text: No bush of the field was yet on the earth and no vegetation of the field had begun sprouting, because Jehovah God had not made it rain on the earth and there was no man to cultivate the ground.

sesotho_text: Jehova Molimo o ne a entse liphoofolo tsohle tse hlaha le libopuoa tsohle tse fofang eaba o li tlisa ho motho ho bona hore na o tla li reha mabitso afe. Li ile tsa bitsoa ka mabitso ao motho a ileng a li reha 'ona.
english_text: Now Jehovah God had been forming from the ground every wild animal of the field and every flying creature of the heavens, and he began bringing them to the man to see what he would call each one; and whatever the man would call each living creature, that became its name.

sesotho_text: Motho a reha liphoofolo tsohle tse ruuoang mabitso le libopuoa tse fofang le liphoofolo tsohle tse hlaha empa motho eena o ne a se na mothusi ea mo tšoanelang.
english_text: So the man named all the domestic animals and the flying creatures of the heavens and every wild animal of the field, but for man there was no helper as a complement of him.

sesotho_text: Motho o shoa kapele joaloka joang. O thunya joaloka palesa ea naheng.
english_text: As for mortal man, his days are like those of grass; He blooms like a blossom of the field.

sesotho_text: Ea e-ba mantsiboea 'me ea e-ba hoseng, letsatsi la bohlano.
english_text: And there was evening and there was morning, a fifth day.

sesotho_text: Eaba Molimo oa li hlohonolofatsa, o re: “Atang le ngatafale 'me le tlale metsi a bolibeng ba maoatle, 'me libōpuoa tse fofang li ke li ngatafale lefatšeng.”
english_text: With that God blessed them, saying: “Be fruitful and become many and fill the waters of the sea, and let the flying creatures become many in the earth.”

sesotho_text: Ho ekelletsa moo, Molimo a ba hlohonolofatsa 'me Molimo a re ho bona: “Atang le ngatafale le tlale lefatše 'me le le buse, 'me le laole litlhapi tsa leoatle le libōpuoa tse fofang tsa maholimo le sebōpuoa se seng le se seng se phelang se hahabang lefatšeng.”
english_text: Further, God blessed them, and God said to them: “Be fruitful and become many, fill the earth and subdue it, and have in subjection the fish of the sea and the flying creatures of the heavens and every living creature that is moving on the earth.”

sesotho_text: Molimo a bitsa leseli Motšehare, empa lefifi a le bitsa Bosiu. Ea e-ba mantsiboea 'me ea e-ba hoseng, letsatsi la pele.
english_text: God called the light Day, but the darkness he called Night. And there was evening and there was morning, a first day.

sesotho_text: Lebitso la noka ea pele ke Pishone. Ke eona e potolohileng naha eohle ea Havila, e nang le khauta.
english_text: The name of the first is Piʹshon; it is the one encircling the entire land of Havʹi·lah, where there is gold.

sesotho_text: Molimo a tsoela pele ho re: “A re etse motho ka setšoantšo sa rōna, ho ea ka sebōpeho sa rōna, 'me ba laole litlhapi tsa leoatle le libōpuoa tse fofang tsa maholimo le liphoofolo tse ruuoang le lefatše lohle le phoofolo e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe e hahabang lefatšeng.”
english_text: Then God said: “Let us make man in our image, according to our likeness, and let them have in subjection the fish of the sea and the flying creatures of the heavens and the domestic animals and all the earth and every creeping animal that is moving on the earth.”

sesotho_text: Monna a re: “Joale enoa ke lesapo la masapo a kaLe nama ea nama ea ka. O tla bitsoa MosaliHobane o nkiloe ho monna.”
english_text: Then the man said: “This is at last bone of my bonesAnd flesh of my flesh. This one will be called Woman,Because from man she was taken.”

sesotho_text: Ke ka lebaka leo monna a tla siea ntate oa hae le 'mè oa hae 'me a khomarele mosali oa hae, bobeli ba bona e tla ba nama e le 'ngoe.
english_text: That is why a man will leave his father and his mother and he will stick to his wife, and they will become one flesh.

sesotho_text: Empa le etsise Morena Jesu Kreste 'me le se ke la rera esale pele hore na le tla khotsofatsa litakatso tse fosahetseng joang.
english_text: But put on the Lord Jesus Christ, and do not be planning ahead for the desires of the flesh.

sesotho_text: Molimo a tsoela pele ho re: “Metsi a ke a nyeunye boieane ba meea e phelang 'me libōpuoa tse fofang li ke li fofe holim'a lefatše sepakapakeng sa maholimo.”
english_text: Then God said: “Let the waters swarm with living creatures, and let flying creatures fly above the earth across the expanse of the heavens.”

sesotho_text: Eaba Molimo o tsoela pele ho re: “Bonang! ke le file limela tsohle tse behang peō tse holim'a lefatše lohle le sefate se seng le se seng seo ho sona ho nang le litholoana tsa sefate se behang peō. E ke e be lijo tsa lōna.
english_text: Then God said: “Here I have given to you every seed-bearing plant that is on the entire earth and every tree with seed-bearing fruit. Let them serve as food for you.

sesotho_text: 'Me sebata se seng le se seng sa lefatše le sebōpuoa se seng le se seng se fofang sa maholimo le ntho e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe e tsamaeang lefatšeng eo ho eona ho nang le bophelo e le moea [ke li file] limela tsohle tse tala hore e be lijo.” 'Me ha e-ba joalo.
english_text: And to every wild animal of the earth and to every flying creature of the heavens and to everything moving on the earth in which there is life, I have given all green vegetation for food.” And it was so.

sesotho_text: Jehova Molimo a melisa lifate tsohle tse ntle le tseo litholoana tsa tsona li ka jeoang a ba a melisa sefate sa bophelo hammoho le sefate sa tsebo ea botle le bobe har'a serapa.
english_text: Thus Jehovah God made to grow out of the ground every tree that was pleasing to look at and good for food and also the tree of life in the middle of the garden and the tree of the knowledge of good and bad.

sesotho_text: Molimo a tsoela pele ho re: “Ho ke ho be le mehloli ea leseli sepakapakeng sa maholimo ho etsa karohano pakeng tsa motšehare le bosiu; 'me e tla ba lipontšo le linako tsa selemo le matsatsi le lilemo.
english_text: Then God said: “Let there be luminaries in the expanse of the heavens to make a division between the day and the night, and they will serve as signs for seasons and for days and years.

sesotho_text: Molimo a etsa mehloli e 'meli e meholo ea leseli, mohloli o moholo oa leseli bakeng sa ho laola motšehare le mohloli o monyenyane oa leseli bakeng sa ho laola bosiu, le linaleli.
english_text: And God went on to make the two great luminaries, the greater luminary for dominating the day and the lesser luminary for dominating the night, and also the stars.

sesotho_text: Molimo a hlohonolofatsa letsatsi la bosupa 'me a re lea halalela hobane letsatsing leo o ile a phomola ka mor'a mosebetsi oohle oo a o entseng.
english_text: And God went on to bless the seventh day and to declare it sacred, for on it God has been resting from all the work that he has created, all that he purposed to make.

sesotho_text: Empa ha e le sefate sa tsebo ea botle le bobe, u se ke oa ja litholoana tsa sona hobane letsatsing leo ka lona u li jang, kannete u tla shoa.”
english_text: But as for the tree of the knowledge of good and bad, you must not eat from it, for in the day you eat from it you will certainly die.”

sesotho_text: Eaba Jehova Molimo o re: “Ha ho hotle hore monna a be mong. Ke tla mo etsetsa mothusi ea mo tšoanelang.”
english_text: Then Jehovah God said: “It is not good for the man to continue to be alone. I am going to make a helper for him, as a complement of him.”

sesotho_text: O tseba hantle tsela eo re bopiloeng ka eona, Oa hopola hore re lerole.
english_text: For he well knows how we are formed, Remembering that we are dust.

sesotho_text: Motho e mong le e mong a hlomphe balaoli ba phahameng kaha ba teng ka lebaka la Molimo. Balaoli ba leng teng ba behiloe maemong a bona a fapaneng ke Molimo.
english_text: Let every person be in subjection to the superior authorities, for there is no authority except by God; the existing authorities stand placed in their relative positions by God.

sesotho_text: Ka hona, le na le mabaka a le tlamang hore le mamele, eseng feela hore le balehe kotlo empa hape hore le be le matsoalo a khutsitseng.
english_text: There is therefore compelling reason for you to be in subjection, not only on account of that wrath but also on account of your conscience.

sesotho_text: Ke ka lebaka leo hape le ntšang makhetho hobane Molimo oa ba sebelisa hore ba sebeletse sechaba kamehla.
english_text: That is why you are also paying taxes; for they are God's public servants constantly serving this very purpose.

sesotho_text: Etsoe molao o reng, “U se ke oa feba, u se ke oa bolaea, u se ke oa utsoa, u se ke oa lakatsa lintho tsa motho e mong” le taelo efe kapa efe e teng, e akarelitsoe polelong ena e reng: “U rate moahisani oa hao joalokaha u ithata.”
english_text: For the law code, “You must not commit adultery, you must not murder, you must not steal, you must not covet,” and whatever other commandment there is, is summed up in this saying: “You must love your neighbor as yourself.”

sesotho_text: Le etse lintho tsena hobane lea tseba hore nako e se e fihlile ea hore le tsohe borokong. Nako ea hore re pholosoe e haufi haholo ho feta ha re ne re e-ba balumeli.
english_text: And do this because you know the season, that it is already the hour for you to awake from sleep, for now our salvation is nearer than at the time when we became believers.

sesotho_text: Joale lefatše le ne le se na sebōpeho ebile le se na letho 'me lefifi le ne le le holim'a boliba; matla a sebetsang a Molimo a ne a e-ea koana le koana holim'a metsi.
english_text: Now the earth was formless and desolate, and there was darkness upon the surface of the watery deep, and God's active force was moving about over the surface of the waters.

sesotho_text: 2 Ke tla rorisa Jehova. E se eka le ka mohla nke ke ka lebala lintho tsohle tseo a li entseng.
english_text: 2 Let me praise Jehovah;May I never forget all that he has done.

sesotho_text: Molimo a tsoela pele ho re: “Lefatše le ke le hlahise meea e phelang ho ea ka mefuta ea eona, phoofolo e ruuoang le phoofolo e hahabang le sebata sa lefatše ho ea ka mofuta oa sona.” 'Me ha e-ba joalo.
english_text: Then God said: “Let the earth bring forth living creatures according to their kinds, domestic animals and creeping animals and wild animals of the earth according to their kinds.” And it was so.

sesotho_text: Ho ne ho e-na le noka e tsoang Edene e nosetsang serapa seo 'me ho tloha moo e ne e arohana e e-ba linoka tse 'nè.
english_text: Now there was a river flowing out of Eʹden to water the garden, and from there it divided into four rivers.

sesotho_text: Ka mor'a moo Molimo a bona hore leseli le molemo, 'me Molimo a hlahisa karohano pakeng tsa leseli le lefifi.
english_text: After that God saw that the light was good, and God began to divide the light from the darkness.

sesotho_text: Joale Molimo a etsa sepakapaka 'me a etsa karohano pakeng tsa metsi a lokelang ho ba ka tlas'a sepakapaka le metsi a lokelang ho ba ka holim'a sepakapaka. 'Me ha e-ba joalo.
english_text: Then God went on to make the expanse and divided the waters beneath the expanse from the waters above the expanse. And it was so.

sesotho_text: Ka letsatsi la bosupa, Molimo o ne a qetile mosebetsi oohle oo a neng a o etsa. Ka lona letsatsi leo, a phomola ka mor'a mosebetsi oohle oo a o entseng.
english_text: And by the seventh day, God had completed the work that he had been doing, and he began to rest on the seventh day from all his work that he had been doing.

sesotho_text: Empa moholi o ne o nyoloha fatše 'me o nosetsa lefatše lohle.
english_text: But a mist would go up from the earth, and it watered the entire surface of the ground.

sesotho_text: Jehova Molimo a etsa motho ka lerole la lefatše 'me a bululela moea oa bophelo linkong tsa hae e le hore a phele eaba motho oa phela.
english_text: And Jehovah God went on to form the man out of dust from the ground and to blow into his nostrils the breath of life, and the man became a living person.

sesotho_text: Jehova Molimo a fa motho taelo ena: “U ka ja litholoana tsa lifate tsohle tse serapeng hore u khotsofale.
english_text: Jehovah God also gave this command to the man: “From every tree of the garden you may eat to satisfaction.

sesotho_text: Jehova Molimo a etsa mosali ka khopo eo a e nkileng ho monna eaba o mo tlisa ho monna.
english_text: And Jehovah God built the rib that he had taken from the man into a woman, and he brought her to the man.

sesotho_text: 4 O pholosa bophelo ba hae lebitleng. O pota-potiloe ke lerako le mohau oa hae.
english_text: 4 He reclaims your life from the pit And crowns you with his loyal love and mercy.

sesotho_text: Feela joalokaha bochabela bo le hole le bophirimela,Ka ho tšoanang o suthiselitse liphoso tsa rona hole le rona.
english_text: As far off as the sunrise is from the sunset,So far off from us he has put our transgressions.

sesotho_text: Molimo a tsoela pele ho re: “Lefatše le ke le hlahise joang, limela tse behang peō, lifate tsa litholoana tse behang litholoana ho ea ka mefuta ea tsona, tseo peō ea tsona e leng ho tsona, holim'a lefatše.” 'Me ha e-ba joalo.
english_text: Then God said: “Let the earth cause grass to sprout, seed-bearing plants and fruit trees according to their kinds, yielding fruit along with seed on the earth.” And it was so.

sesotho_text: Lefatše la qala ho hlahise joang, limela tse behang peō ho ea ka mefuta ea tsona le lifate tse behang litholoana, tseo peō ea tsona e leng ho tsona ho ea ka mefuta ea tsona. Joale Molimo a bona hore ho molemo.
english_text: And the earth began to produce grass, seed-bearing plants and trees yielding fruit along with seed, according to their kinds. Then God saw that it was good.

sesotho_text: Ho ekelletsa moo, Jehova Molimo a lema serapa Edene, ho elella ka bochabela 'me a beha motho eo a mo entseng teng.
english_text: Further, Jehovah God planted a garden in Eʹden, toward the east; and there he put the man whom he had formed.

sesotho_text: Empa moholi o ne o nyoloha fatše 'me o nosetsa lefatše lohle.
english_text: But a mist would go up from the earth, and it watered the entire surface of the ground.

sesotho_text: Feela joalokaha maholimo a phahametse lefatše haholo,Ba mo tšabang o ba rata haholo.
english_text: For as the heavens are high above the earth, So great is His mercy toward those who fear Him;

sesotho_text: Jehova o tšoara bohle ba hateletsoeng ka tokaLe ka tsela e lokileng.
english_text: The LORD executes righteousness And justice for all who are oppressed.

sesotho_text: Motho o shoa kapele joaloka joang. O thunya joaloka palesa ea naheng.
english_text: As for man, his days are like grass; As a flower of the field, so he flourishes.

sesotho_text: Feela joalokaha bochabela bo le hole le bophirimela,Ka ho tšoanang o suthiselitse liphoso tsa rona hole le rona.
english_text: As far as the east is from the west, So far has He removed our transgressions from us.

sesotho_text: Jehova o mohau 'me o na le kutloelo-bohloko,O lieha ho halefa ebile o lerato.
english_text: The LORD is merciful and gracious, Slow to anger, and abounding in mercy.

sesotho_text: Ke tla rorisa Jehova. E se eka le ka mohla nke ke ka lebala lintho tsohle tseo a li entseng.
english_text: Bless the LORD, O my soul, And forget not all His benefits:

sesotho_text: Ke tla rorisa Jehova,Ke rorise lebitso la hae le halalelang ka pelo ea ka eohle.
english_text: A Psalm of David. Bless the LORD, O my soul; And all that is within me, bless His holy name!

sesotho_text: Rorisang Jehova, lona mabotho 'ohle a hae,Lona basebeletsi ba hae, ba etsang thato ea hae.
english_text: Bless the LORD, all you His hosts, You ministers of His, who do His pleasure.

sesotho_text: Rorisang Jehova, lona mangeloi 'ohle a hae a matla,A phethang litaelo tsa hae le ho mo mamela.
english_text: Bless the LORD, you His angels, Who excel in strength, who do His word, Heeding the voice of His word.

sesotho_text: Empa ha moea o foka, ea nyamelaJoalokaha eka ha e e-s'o ka e e-ba teng.
english_text: For the wind passes over it, and it is gone, And its place remembers it no more.

sesotho_text: A ke ke a lula a re tšoaea liphosoEbile a ke ke a lula a re halefetse.
english_text: He will not always strive with us, Nor will He keep His anger forever.

sesotho_text: O pholosa bophelo ba hae lebitleng. O pota-potiloe ke lerako le mohau oa hae.
english_text: Who redeems your life from destruction, Who crowns you with lovingkindness and tender mercies,

sesotho_text: O etsa joalo ho ba bolokang selekane sa haeLe ho ba ikemiselitseng ho latela litaelo tsa hae.
english_text: To such as keep His covenant, And to those who remember His commandments to do them.

sesotho_text: Jehova o hauhetse ba mo tšabangFeela joalokaha ntate a hauhela bana ba hae.
english_text: As a father pities his children, So the LORD pities those who fear Him.

sesotho_text: Jehova o tiisitse terone ea hae maholimong. Ebile o busa ntho e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe.
english_text: The LORD has established His throne in heaven, And His kingdom rules over all.

sesotho_text: O tseba hantle tsela eo re bopiloeng ka eona,Oa hopola hore re lerole.
english_text: For He knows our frame; He remembers that we are dust.

sesotho_text: Rorisang Jehova hohle moo a busang teng,Lona mesebetsi eohle ea hae. E se eka nka rorisa Jehova ka pelo eohle ea ka.
english_text: Bless the LORD, all His works, In all places of His dominion. Bless the LORD, O my soul!

sesotho_text: O mo fa lintho tse mo khotsofatsang bophelo bohle ba haeHore a lule a le mocha a bile a e-na le matla joaloka ntsu.
english_text: Who satisfies your mouth with good things, So that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.

sesotho_text: O tšoarela motho liphoso tsohleEbile o folisa bohloko bohle boo motho a bo utloang.
english_text: Who forgives all your iniquities, Who heals all your diseases,

sesotho_text: O ile a tsebisa Moshe mesebetsi ea hae,A tsebisa Baiseraele liketso tsa hae.
english_text: He made known His ways to Moses, His acts to the children of Israel.

sesotho_text: Ha a re fe kotlo e re tšoanelang ho latela libe tsa ronaEbile ha a re fe moputso o re tšoanelang ho latela liphoso tsa rona.
english_text: He has not dealt with us according to our sins, Nor punished us according to our iniquities.

sesotho_text: Motho e mong le e mong a hlomphe balaoli ba phahameng kaha ba teng ka lebaka la Molimo. Balaoli ba leng teng ba behiloe maemong a bona a fapaneng ke Molimo.
english_text: Let every soul be subject to the governing authorities. For there is no authority except from God, and the authorities that exist are appointed by God.

sesotho_text: Bosiu bo se bo tla sa, letsatsi le atametse. Ka hona, a re hloboleng mesebetsi ea lefifi 'me re apareng lihlomo tsa leseli.
english_text: The night is far spent, the day is at hand. Therefore let us cast off the works of darkness, and let us put on the armor of light.

sesotho_text: Fang bohle tse ba lokelang, ea batlang lekhetho la mofuta ofe kapa ofe le mo fe lona, ea batlang ho tšajoa le mo tšabe, ea batlang ho hlomphuoa le mo hlomphe.
english_text: Render therefore to all their due: taxes to whom taxes are due, customs to whom customs, fear to whom fear, honor to whom honor.

sesotho_text: Le se ke la kolota mang kapa mang letho haese lerato kaha ea ratang oa habo o phethahalitse molao.
english_text: Owe no one anything except to love one another, for he who loves another has fulfilled the law.

sesotho_text: A re itšoareng hantle joalokaha batho ba itšoara hantle motšehare. Re se ke ra tsamaea liphathi tse sa laoleheng, ra tahoa, ra etsa boitšoaro bo bobe bo amanang le thobalano, ra etsa boitšoaro bo bobe re sa soabe, ra loana kapa ra monela batho ba bang.
english_text: Let us walk properly, as in the day, not in revelry and drunkenness, not in lewdness and lust, not in strife and envy.

sesotho_text: Ea ratang oa habo ha a mo etse hampe. Kahoo, ho ba le lerato ke ho etsa seo molao o se laelang.
english_text: Love does no harm to a neighbor; therefore love is the fulfillment of the law.

sesotho_text: Empa le etsise Morena Jesu Kreste 'me le se ke la rera esale pele hore na le tla khotsofatsa litakatso tse fosahetseng joang.
english_text: But put on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make no provision for the flesh, to fulfill its lusts.

sesotho_text: Ke ka lebaka leo hape le ntšang makhetho hobane Molimo oa ba sebelisa hore ba sebeletse sechaba kamehla.
english_text: For because of this you also pay taxes, for they are God’s ministers attending continually to this very thing.

sesotho_text: Ka hona, ea hanyetsang bolaoli o hanyetsa seo Molimo a se thehileng 'me ba se hanyetsang ba tla ahloloa.
english_text: Therefore whoever resists the authority resists the ordinance of God, and those who resist will bring judgment on themselves.
